Your firm repeatedly failed to follow SOP-CAPS-4000693, titled Quality System procedure, Notification of Quality Event (NQE), v 11, dated 2023-05-31, section 6.1 which states, "Any employee aware of an issue that meets the above definition of Quality Event shall:...Immediately upon observing or becoming aware of an event, inform the DOP [Director of Pharmacy] or Quality Manager [Director of Quality]... During the inspection, we observed three different methods of communicating incident events and no NQE was ever initiated.
